notes.title: The Fabulous Fear Machine - Now Available on Mac
notes.notes:
Just in time for the Steam Autumn Sale, pulp horror strategy comes to Mac computers with The Fabulous Fear Machine!

The Fabulous Fear Machine offers a globe-trotting single player campaign for fans of narrative and strategy games alike. Each of three story chapters focuses on a new Master of the Machine: from a scientist’s conquest of the pharmaceutical market in Eurasia, to a small-town insurance salesman’s fumbling foray into local politics, to a hell-raising tale of televangelism in the Americas.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.28
notes.notes:
We've been continuing to work on the game in order to make it even more enjoyable, and we've implemented a list of fixes and improvements in the last update:

[list]
[*] There is no missing text in any language now.
[*] We have enhanced the CONTINUE button, which sometimes worked in unexpected ways.
[*] We changed the encoding of the cutscenes, so now they should work smoothly on every version of the Steam Deck (external mouse and keyboard are recommended!).
[*] A new "Legends viewer" feature has been added to the Album.
[*] Small bugs were fixed
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support. We hope you're enjoying The Fabulous Fear Machine as much as we enjoyed creating it!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We're continuing to work on the game, and we've implemented a list of minor fixes and significant improvements in the latest update:

[list]
[*] We have enhanced the CONTINUE button, which now displays information about the game that is to be continued
[*] We resolved a bug in the Essences locator that was not behaving as expected after loading a game
[*] Some adjustments have been made to the HUD since certain parts of it were making it challenging to interact with specific gameplay elements
[*] We've addressed glitches that were affecting certain graphic resolutions
[*] We've reviewed and made some minor adjustments to a few maps
[/list]

We are aware of ongoing issues and fixes that still need attention. Here is a list of some of the problems we are currently addressing:

[list]
[*] The CONTINUE feature still does not behave as expected in very, very specific instances
[*] There are still a few (very few) texts that do not appear correctly in certain languages
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you're enjoying our game!

notes.title: Community Items are Live! with Patch 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We're excited to share that Community Items (like Steam Trading Cards) are now live for The Fabulous Fear Machine.

We've been working on the game since its launch, and we've got a list of minor fixes and significant improvements in the latest update:

[list]
[*] We fixed a bug that was affecting games in which a region was in a "Barren  Land" state
[*] We addressed glitches affecting very wide graphic resolutions
[*] We corrected errors in the object drag system for less common resolutions
[*] We adjusted some texts
[*] We fixed various bugs
[/list]

We are aware of ongoing issues and fixes that still need to be addressed. Here is a list of some of the problems we are currently working on:

[list]
[*] Sometimes, especially when not playing 'linearly,' the CONTINUE button on the main menu does not work as expected
[*] We will review minor adjustments on some maps
[*] There are still a few (very few) texts that do not appear in certain languages
[/list]

Thanks for your continuing support and hope you’re enjoying our game!

notes.title: The Fabulous Fear Machine Launches October 4th
notes.notes:
After many years, gaining power in the shadows, The Fabulous Fear Machine will reveal itself to the world on October 4th at 12pm Eastern / 18:00 CEST.

The Fabulous Fear Machine offers a globe-trotting single player campaign for fans of narrative and strategy games alike. Each of three story chapters focuses on a new Master of the Machine: from a scientist’s conquest of the pharmaceutical market in Eurasia, to a small-town insurance salesman’s fumbling foray into local politics, to a hell-raising tale of televangelism in the Americas.

The game's demo will remain available this weekend and as a part of a special narrative game festival starting on Monday, so this is your last chance to check it out before the game's release on Wednesday.

notes.title: The Fabulous Fear Machine at IndieCade and Indie X!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413378/b25fe42155b8f52784300e295b5eaca1d8563844.jpg[/img]

IndieCade and Indie X are international events showcasing the future of indie games; [i]The Fabulous Fear Machine[/i] is a nominee for Best Visual Art at IndieCade 2022. [i]The Fabulous Fear Machine[/i]'s demo will be available for anyone to download during these events, from November 3-13.

You’ve just become the newest Master of the Machine, and now you must generate fear and expand your influence by playing Legend cards: those scary stories, urban myths, and conspiracy theories that lurk in the dark corners of the mind. To clear a path for your Legends to grow, you’ll dispatch your Agents to new locations on the map, harvest and manage resources, decide how to deal with events in the simulation, and spy on the operations of your foes.

Check it out before the event ends on November 13!
